identity.identity_match: OSM way is explicitly named Campus Edge and carries address 134 Pierce Street; the Indiana 2016-2020 building footprint overlaps the OSM polygon at 0.914 IoU and 1.06 m centroid separation in the project's documented local approximation. The 2023 Indiana orthophoto confirms the matching roof outline.

sources.source_date: way timestamp 2020-12-19; node edits include later updates
sources.method: Use the tagged building polygon as the independent identity and roof-height raster sampling outline; compare against Indiana LiDAR footprint.
sources.uncertainty: Community-maintained geometry; not a cadastral or architectural survey.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Hosted Building Footprints FeatureServer
sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 WGS 84 in saved query response
sources.method: Extrude this 13-vertex footprint after projecting each vertex with the local conversion documented in modular/README.md. Simplify only near-collinear vertices within 0.30 m. Independent comparison with OSM way 886359911 gives 0.914 IoU and a 1.06 m centroid gap.
sources.uncertainty: Aerial/LiDAR roof footprint may differ from wall footprint; local degree conversion is approximate and not surveyed.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana 3DEP LiDAR normalized digital height model
sources.feature: Tile in2018_30001880_12; Tippecanoe County; footprint tile index OBJECTID 14401
sources.source_crs: EPSG:2968 NAD83(HARN) / Indiana West (US survey feet), 5 ft cells
sources.method: Sample 2018 5-ft NDHM pixel centers inside OSM way 886359911; whole-outline median is about 36.12 m. A second reproducible analysis summarizes three north/middle/south roof bands using the 2023 orthophoto extent and approximate campus local conversion.
sources.uncertainty: 5-ft cells mix roof edges, trees, and rooftop elements; NDHM is a normalized surface and does not establish eaves or story count. Orthophoto-derived per-tower bands are approximate, not surveyed.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, DynamicWebMercator Indiana 2023 Imagery ImageServer
sources.feature: Orthophoto crop around Campus Edge, 1800 x 1800 px
sources.source_date: 2023 imagery; service metadata and crop retrieved 2026-10-25
sources.source_crs: ImageServer export in Web Mercator; extent saved in indiana_2023_orthophoto_metadata.json
sources.method: Visual check of roof outline and qualitative interpretation of three north-to-south roof-pad intervals separated by two dark courtyard/recess bands; row intervals use the saved EPSG:4326 extent and project local conversion, summarized in campus_edge_roof_zone_analysis.json.
sources.uncertainty: Orthophoto roof surfaces are not structural wall boundaries. Row-derived pad boundaries use an approximate local conversion and are clipped to the GIS footprint, not surveyed tower outlines.

sources.provider: American Campus Communities, official property page and gallery
sources.feature: Official property identity/address, property hero and secondary exterior images, and full gallery snapshot set (18 images)
sources.source_date: Current property page retrieved 2026-10-25; photo date not stated
sources.method: The gallery contact sheet was used to inspect the full official image set for building-specific exterior evidence. The primary oblique exterior image supports qualitative facade composition, balcony zones, podium, and multiple tower volumes; the saved orthophoto remains the source for plan/roof-pad interpretation. Other gallery images are preserved as source snapshots for provenance and cross-checking.
sources.uncertainty: Photo does not provide measured dimensions or establish exact locations of facade elements.

roof_plan_interpretation.status: qualitative photo interpretation georeferenced through orthophoto extent and approximate local projection
roof_plan_interpretation.interpretation: Three separate north/middle/south roof-pad masses with two major open/recessed roof bands above the continuous low podium. Upper mass facades follow each pad boundary, leaving the recess bands open.
roof_plan_interpretation.uncertainty: Roof-pad boundaries are interpreted from 2023 orthophoto rows transformed using its saved extent, then clipped to the GIS ring; exact tower wall lines and courtyard elevations are not surveyed.
